author: Gmelin, 1789
status: 겨울철새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수백 마리

months.note: 국내 산란기는 3월 중순~4월 중순이고, 다른 지역에서는 6~7월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 해마다 수만 마리가 겨울을 나는 겨울철새이자 수백 마리가 찾아오는 여름철새로, 주로 섬에서 번식한다. 바닷가와 육지의 연못 등에서 지내며, 겨울에는 몇 마리에서 수천 마리에 이르는 무리가 바다 위를 줄지어 떠다니며 잠수한다. 작은 물고기, 갑각류, 조개 같은 연체동물을 잡아먹는다. 국내에서는 알을 1~2개, 때로 3개 낳으며 강원도, 경상북도, 전라남도, 제주도 등지에서 볼 수 있다.

art.subject: Ancient Murrelet (Synthliboramphus antiquus), adult in winter plumage, as seen on Korean seas from November to February: black crown, nape and face down to just below the eye, sharply cut off from the white throat; back, scapulars and wings slate-grey; breast, belly and flanks white. Bill short and stubby, pale ivory to pinkish-white. Dark eye.
art.pose: swimming on the sea in a loose line with others, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter sea off a rocky island, calm grey water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view swimming low on the sea: black cap from forehead to nape reaching just below the eye, white throat and breast, slate-grey back, short pale stubby bill

adult breeding (March–April), side view standing upright on a rock at a breeding island: black head and throat bib, fine white plumes streaking above and behind the eye, slate-grey back, white breast and underparts, pale bill
art.build: Small, compact auk, about 25cm, a little shorter than a feral pigeon but chunkier; thick-necked with a rounded head, a very short stubby bill much shorter than the head, small pointed wings and a very short tail. Sits low on the water, legs set far back and seldom seen. Flies low and fast with whirring wingbeats, the grey back contrasting with the black head and the underwing mostly white. Often swims in long lines on the open sea and dives from the surface.
avoid: Do not paint a long, pointed dagger bill — that is a guillemot; this murrelet's bill is short, stubby and pale.
Do not paint a white wing patch or white spectacles around the eye (Spectacled Guillemot, Cepphus carbo).
Do not paint the black throat bib on winter birds; in winter the throat is white.
Do not paint it tall and upright like a penguin when swimming; it sits low and compact.
